deep_analysis.text: Cross-asset signals are split: equities firmer, VIX sharply lower and gold nudging higher point toward risk-on, while the yen's broad advance and softer dollar tone in headlines suggest funding-currency unwind rather than pure risk appetite. Copper's gain and stable yields add a modestly constructive growth undertone, though WTI's drop tempers commodity-bloc conviction. Headlines center on diverging central bank paths, with Fed hike bets firming even as the dollar struggles broadly. Near-term focus sits squarely on US CPI and PPI, alongside the ECB, BoE, BoC, and RBNZ decisions within the next day, all likely to reset rate-differential expectations across major blocs.
